title: Component manifest
description: The format of components/<name>/component.toml. See README.md#the-manifest for the meaning of each field.

name.description: The component's name. It is the same as its directory under components/.

description.description: One sentence: what the component sets up.

base.description: Whether every project gets the component, with the others. A base component has no `detect` and no `directory`: its files, such as the root Makefile and README.md, are at the repository root.

directory.description: The project's subdirectory that the component's files are in, such as `server`, or a table that names it from an input's value. The `detect` and `infer` rules read files there, and the steps run there. The scaffold has the component's files under it, or under `{{directory}}` when an input names it, and its workflows in .github/workflows/, named with the component's name first.

oneOf.description: The directory for each value of an input, such as `{ input = "platform", names = { ios = "ios", tvos = "tvos" } }`. The detect rules look in each; the component's directory is the first they match, or else the one the input's value names.

input.description: The name of the input whose value names the directory.

names.description: The directory for each of the input's values.

blurb.description: A summary of the component's part of the project, which bootstrap writes in the root README.md between the component's markers, with a link to the README.md in `directory`.

detect.description: Required unless `base` is true. How to know, from its files only, that a repository uses the component. The component is detected when every rule in `all` matches and, if `any` has rules, at least one of them matches.

inputs.description: Values that differ per project. An input with no `infer`, or whose value is not found, is asked for one time.

secrets.description: Secrets the component needs, by name: GitHub Actions secrets, and, with scope `local`, values kept only in the owner's Keychain. Values are never in the manifest.

steps.description: Ordered. Each step's check runs; when it fails, its fix runs, or becomes a Needs human issue.

shared.description: The reusable pieces that the component uses, in this repository or another.

docs.description: Anchors in the superlinear guide (docs/anchors.md) that explain the component.

glob.description: A path glob, relative to the repository root. `**` matches any number of directories.

contains.description: A regular expression that the contents of at least one matching file must match.

default.description: The value to use when no `infer` rule finds one, instead of asking.

infer.description: Where to read the value from the repository, tried in order. The first value found is used.

map.description: Replaces the value found with the value of its key. A value with no key is not found.

oneOf.description: A build setting, as `xcodebuild -showBuildSettings` prints it for the project's scheme.
The first argument of a call in a fastlane configuration file, such as `team_id("...")` in fastlane/Appfile. For an array, the values joined with commas.
A value in a TOML file, by its dotted key path.
A value in a YAML file, by its dotted key path. For a list, the values joined with `separator`, a comma by default.

The path of the first file that matches the glob and, when `contains` is set, whose contents match it; its name without the directory and the extension when `stem` is set; or `true` and `false` when `exists` is set.
The first capture group of a regular expression in the first file that matches the glob.

human.description: A step a person must do. The text becomes a Needs human issue.

twoFactor.description: True when the step needs a two-factor prompt, so it cannot be done unattended.

source.description: Where bootstrap reads the value: a Keychain item, a 1Password reference, or a value it generates and stores in the Keychain.

scope.description: team: one value for every project; app: one value per app; repo: one value per repository. Each of those is a GitHub Actions secret. local: one value, kept only in the owner's Keychain for commands run on their Mac, and never set as a GitHub secret; its source is a Keychain item.

rotateEvery.description: How often to make a new value: a number of days, weeks, months or years, such as 365d or 1y.

scope.description: app: done one time for each app; repo: one time for the repository. Defaults to repo.

check.description: A shell command, run at the repository root. Exit status 0 means the step is done.

fix.description: A shell command that does the step, or a human step.

repo.description: The GitHub repository that has the piece, as owner/name, when it is not this one.

path.description: The path in this repository, or in `repo`.

version.description: The first tag of this repository that has the piece in its current form; or, with `repo`, the tag of that repository that projects call it at, such as a major version tag.

anchor.description: An anchor that docs/anchors.md in the superlinear repository lists, as <page>.md#<id>.
